summary: Install-time host identifier beacon to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: package.json wires preinstall, install, and postinstall to node install.js, which POSTs a JSON payload containing the machine hostname, OS username, current working directory, hook name, and package name to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at http://180.184.38.134:53177/hit/gfe-lx-watcher. The beacon fires unconditionally on npm install with no opt-in and no user-configurable destination. The README self-labels the package as a 'dependency-confusion research placeholder' for an internal @gfe scope, but the actual code shape is an install-time reconnaissance beacon that identifies any developer or CI host that resolves the internal name against the public registry. The destination is a bare IP over cleartext HTTP, not the publisher's documented infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
